body:
Current USD equivalent balance in the diversification fund A: ~ 3049.4
The requested amount for DiversiGen fund creation: 3000 USD equivalent

Thus we will encode a remark-based referendum for this proposal which will be the first remark-based referendum in this series which could have up to 4 remark-based referendum referenda as follows:
- Referendum 1: Form the DiversiGen fund from the diversification fund A (without the need of liquidating any non-stable tokens from the older fund.) {Current holdings: 969.3207 USDT on Ethereum, 963 USDT on BSC and 1116.2365 sUSD on Kwenta on Optimism.}


- Referendum 2: Transfer of the whole custody to the multisigs with active contributors and community members as signers. [Multisig threshold: 7/10, Proposed signers: Bharthcoorg, BugZ, Moonrocket, JelliedOwl, Zerom, Gagan, Raj, Rama, Pranav, Shankar]. Further, stake those tokens if any corresponding native staking is available. If the community passes 'Referendum 1', the transfer of custody here implies the transfer of remainder tokens post-creation of the DiversiGen fund.


- Referendum 3: {This referendum will be raised only if the community denies the 'Referendum 2'.} Complete liquidation of the diversification fund A to EDGs and transfer those EDGs to the on-chain treasury. If the community passes 'Referendum 1', the liquidation here implies the liquidation of the remainder tokens post-creation of the DiversiGen fund.


- Referendum 4: {This referendum will be raised only if community denies the 'Referendum 3' as well as 'Referendum 1'.} Liquidation of only the stable tokens to EDGs and transferring those EDGs to the on-chain treasury while transferring the custody to the multisigs with active contributors and community members as signers. [Multisig threshold: 7/10, Proposed signers: Bharthcoorg, BugZ, Moonrocket, JelliedOwl, Zerom, Gagan, Raj, Rama, Pranav, Shankar]. Further, stake those tokens if any corresponding native staking is available.

The first remark-based referendum is now live:
Democracy Proposal: #95
Most likely to become the Referendum: #148 (unless someone proposes any other democracy proposal(s) in this launch period cycle and have more endorsements/ signalling votes.)

If the community approves this remark-based referendum, DiversiGen fund (to be managed by Zerom) will be created. Outcomes of the 'Referendum 1' do not influence the need of up to 3 more remark-based referenda in this series as proposed by the maintainers of the older 'diversification fund A'.

Closed two Council Motions (**#123** & **#124**) together. Due to the **external queue limit (1)**, the **#123** proposal got removed from the queue upon closing the **#124** proposal.


Thus, re-proposing the Council Motion **#123** as the new Council Motion **#125** (for the creation of a **simpleMajority Referendum**) using the same preimage:
https://www.edgeware.app/?rpc=wss%3A%2F%2Fedgeware.jelliedowl.net#/extrinsics/decode/0x0b02200a05983ebdf31e2c51ce3e8b2d9d5ca968005e1592308b2751d138f2d6f641587c7ea8


Older extrinsic (for **#123**):
https://edgscan.ink/#/extrinsics/21140545-2


Newer Extrinsic (for **#125**):
https://edgscan.ink/#/extrinsics/21191410-2

Hey, [@mark](/profile/id/131742). Thank you for your comment. I would want to highlight that it will help the Edgeware since existing active contributors who are working unpaid beginning in November 2021 will receive some funds to use for their expenses, which will motivate them to concentrate on Edgeware development. Last but not least, we can support the minimal exchange listings, partnerships, community events, marketing, and so on for the growth of the Edgeware token, as determined by the community before proceeding.
Does an opinion/comment even matter? When the outcome of referenda depends on who has more EDGs whatever the intent might be.

**I would rather not to take funding from the Edgeware treasury for these $3000 funds. I want to leverage the previous Diversification Funds treasury holdings, which contain $2678 in stable coins, to liquidate some of the tokens at market prices.**
